description: Cross-SDK padding test vectors. All SDKs (Rust, Go, Python, JS, C++, Dart, Flutter) MUST produce/consume these padded payloads correctly.

vectors.name: one_block_minus_overhead
vectors.description: 1011 zero bytes (fits in one block with min prefix)

vectors.name: exactly_one_block
vectors.description: 1015 bytes (exactly fills one block after prefix+overhead)

cross_sdk_tests.name: roundtrip_all_sdks
cross_sdk_tests.description: Each SDK pads plaintext, all other SDKs unpad and recover original

cross_sdk_tests.name: size_distribution
cross_sdk_tests.description: 64 trials on fixed plaintext must yield >= 2 distinct sizes (SIBNA-2026-018)
